blocks.text: Yeh chapter 29 (Spectroscopy-1) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har sawal 4 number ka hai (wazahat, equations, zaroorat ho to diagram), aur chapter ke numericals qadam ba qadam hal kiye gaye hain. Har sawal ka poora model jawab hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Describe the nature of electromagnetic radiation. State Planck's quantum theory and write the expressions for the energy of radiation. (4 marks)
(Electromagnetic radiation ki nature bayan karein. Planck ki quantum theory likhein aur radiation ki energy ke expressions likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Nature: light aur doosri electromagnetic radiation oscillating electric aur magnetic fields ki waves ki shakal mein chalti hain. Yeh waves wavelength (λ, m mein) aur frequency (ν, Hz ya s⁻¹ mein) se bayan hoti hain aur light ki speed c = 3.0 × 10⁸ m/s se chalti hain:
c = λν

Electromagnetic spectrum mein radio waves, microwaves, infrared, visible light, ultraviolet, X-rays aur gamma rays shamil hain.

Planck ki quantum theory:
1. Atoms aur molecules sirf discrete (alag alag) miqdaar mein energy kharij ya jazb karte hain. Quantum energy electromagnetic radiation ki sab se chhoti miqdaar hai jo kharij ya jazb ho sakti hai.
2. Radiation ki frequency aur us ki energy directly proportional hain.

Radiation ki energy:
E = hν = hc/λ = hcν̄ (ν̄ = 1/λ, wavenumber cm⁻¹ mein)
jahan h = Planck's constant = 6.626 × 10⁻³⁴ J s. Frequency barhne se energy barhti hai aur wavelength barhne se kam hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: These waves are defined by their wavelength (λ) and frequency (ν)

blocks.prompt:
2 Sodium gives a strong yellow line at 589 nm. Calculate (i) the frequency, (ii) the energy of one photon and (iii) the wavenumber in cm⁻¹ of this radiation (h = 6.626 × 10⁻³⁴ J s, c = 3.0 × 10⁸ m/s). (4 marks)
(Sodium 589 nm par mazboot peeli line deta hai. Is radiation ki (i) frequency, (ii) aik photon ki energy aur (iii) wavenumber cm⁻¹ mein nikalein (h = 6.626 × 10⁻³⁴ J s, c = 3.0 × 10⁸ m/s).)
blocks.explanation: nm ko m mein badlein, ν = c/λ lagayein, phir E = hν, aur ν̄ = 1/λ jahan λ cm mein ho.

book_ref.quote: h = Planck's constant (6.626×10⁻³⁴ J.s)

blocks.prompt:
3 Compare the energy of one photon of visible light of frequency 6.0 × 10¹⁴ Hz with that of infrared radiation of wavenumber 1700 cm⁻¹. Also find the wavelength of the visible light (h = 6.626 × 10⁻³⁴ J s, c = 3.0 × 10⁸ m/s). (4 marks)
(6.0 × 10¹⁴ Hz frequency wali visible light ke aik photon ki energy ka 1700 cm⁻¹ wavenumber wali infrared radiation se muqabla karein. Visible light ki wavelength bhi nikalein (h = 6.626 × 10⁻³⁴ J s, c = 3.0 × 10⁸ m/s).)
blocks.explanation: Visible photon ke liye E = hν aur IR photon ke liye E = hcν̄ lagayein; ν̄ ko m⁻¹ mein badlein taake c (m/s) se units milein.

book_ref.quote: The frequency of a radiation and the energy it carries are directly proportional to each other

steps: Tanasub = 3.98 × 10⁻¹⁹ / 3.38 × 10⁻²⁰ ≈ 11.8; visible photon taqreeban 12 guna zyada energy rakhta hai
blocks.final_answer: λ = 500 nm; E(visible) = 3.98 × 10⁻¹⁹ J; E(IR) = 3.38 × 10⁻²⁰ J; visible photon ≈ 12 guna zyada energy

blocks.prompt:
4 Define the index of hydrogen deficiency (IHD). Explain with examples how it is related to rings and multiple bonds, and give its importance. (4 marks)
(Index of hydrogen deficiency (IHD) ki definition likhein. Misaalon se samjhayein ke yeh rings aur multiple bonds se kaise mutaliq hai, aur is ki ahmiyat batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Definition: degree of unsaturation (U) ya index of hydrogen deficiency (IHD) compound aur usi tadaad ke carbon wale acyclic alkane ke darmiyan hydrogen atoms ke joron ki tadaad ka farq hai. Har do ghaib hydrogen atoms par aik degree of unsaturation.

Rings aur multiple bonds: har double bond ya ring saturated compound ke muqable mein do hydrogen kam karta hai, is liye aik IHD barhata hai; triple bond do IHD barhata hai.
Misaal 1: 1-hexene aur cyclohexane (dono C₆H₁₂) hexane se do hydrogen kam hain, is liye IHD = 1 (aik double bond / aik ring).
Misaal 2: C₄H₆ C₄H₁₀ se chaar hydrogen kam hai, is liye IHD = 2.

Ahmiyat:
1. Yeh sirf molecular formula dekh kar mil jata hai aur composition aur structure ke ishare deta hai.
2. IHD = 0: koi ring ya double bond nahi. IHD = 1: aik ring ya aik double bond, dono nahi. IHD = 2: do rings, do double bonds, aik aik, ya aik triple bond.
3. Bina complex analytical techniques ke maloomat deta hai aur batata hai ke compound ke liye kaun si technique behtar hogi.

book_ref.quote: The deficiency of hydrogen corresponds to the degree of unsaturation of a compound

rows: 1: aik double bond ya aik ring
2: do double bonds, do rings, aik double bond aur aik ring, ya aik triple bond

blocks.prompt:
5 Calculate the IHD of the hydrocarbons (i) C₅H₁₀, (ii) C₇H₁₂, (iii) C₆H₆ and (iv) C₁₀H₈, and state what each value allows. (4 marks)
(Hydrocarbons (i) C₅H₁₀, (ii) C₇H₁₂, (iii) C₆H₆ aur (iv) C₁₀H₈ ka IHD nikalein aur batayein har qeemat kya ijazat deti hai.)
blocks.explanation: Har formula ko usi carbon tadaad wale acyclic alkane CₙH₂ₙ₊₂ se milayein; har ghaib hydrogen jora aik IHD hai.

book_ref.quote: Each double bond or ring costs two hydrogen atoms compared to a saturated analog

steps: C₅H₁₀: alkane C₅H₁₂; (12 − 10)/2 = 1 → aik ring ya aik double bond
C₇H₁₂: alkane C₇H₁₆; (16 − 12)/2 = 2 → do double bonds, do rings, aik aik, ya aik triple bond
C₆H₆: alkane C₆H₁₄; (14 − 6)/2 = 4 → maslan aik ring aur teen double bonds
C₁₀H₈: alkane C₁₀H₂₂; (22 − 8)/2 = 7 → kul saat rings aur/ya double bonds

blocks.prompt:
6 Explain how an absorption spectrum is produced. Why do its dark lines appear at the same wavelengths as the lines of the emission spectrum of the same element? (4 marks)
(Absorption spectrum kaise banta hai, samjhayein. Is ki kaali lines usi element ke emission spectrum ki lines wali wavelengths par kyun aati hain?)
blocks.explanation:
Banna: safaid light ko thandi, kam pressure wali gas se guzara jata hai. Ground state ke electrons energy jazb kar ke ooper energy states mein jate hain. Sirf woh photons jazb hote hain jin ki energy electrons ko excite karne ke liye bilkul barabar ho; baqi wavelengths guzar jati hain.

Shakal: har jazb shuda photon aik khaas wavelength hai jo rangeen background par kaali line ki shakal mein dikhti hai.

Lines aik jagah kyun: atom mein electrons sirf discrete energy levels ke darmiyan jaate hain. Emission mein excite electrons (maslan garam kam pressure gas mein) neeche levels par aa kar levels ke farq ke barabar energy ke photons kharij karte hain, jo kaale background par rangeen lines dete hain. Absorption mein wohi farq ooper ki taraf tay hote hain, is liye bilkul unhi energies (wavelengths) ke photons jazb hote hain.

Is liye absorption spectrum ki lines usi element ke emission spectrum ki lines se milti hain: absorption spectrum emission spectrum ka photographic negative hai.

book_ref.quote: Absorption spectra can be produced by passing white light through a cool, low-pressure gas

blocks.prompt:
7 What is spectroscopy? Explain how atomic spectra are used to identify elements, giving the examples of hydrogen, sodium and mercury, and one other application. (4 marks)
(Spectroscopy kya hai? Samjhayein ke atomic spectra elements ki pehchan mein kaise kaam aate hain, hydrogen, sodium aur mercury ki misaalon ke saath, aur aik aur istemal batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Spectroscopy electromagnetic radiation aur matter ke amal se bane spectra ki paidaish, paimaish aur tashreeh ka ilm hai. Spectrum atomic aur molecular energy levels, molecular geometry, molecules ke amal aur chemical bonds ki nature batata hai. Yeh substance ki miqdaar napne (quantitative analysis) ya na-maloom sample pehchanne (qualitative analysis) mein kaam aata hai.

Elements ki pehchan: emission aur absorption spectra se substance ki chemical composition maloom ki ja sakti hai. Har element lines ka munfarid pattern deta hai; koi do elements aik jaisa set nahi dete. Is liye emission line spectra fingerprints ki tarah hain.
• Hydrogen: 656 nm par mazboot surkh line.
• Sodium: khaas peela shola, 589 nm par mazboot lines.
• Mercury: zyada tar lines 450 nm se neeche, khaas neeli light.

Aik aur istemal: astronomers sitaron ki kharij light ke atomic spectra se sitaron ki chemical composition maloom karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Each element produces a unique pattern of spectral lines

blocks.prompt:
8 Explain the principle of UV-Visible spectroscopy: what is measured, how absorbance is obtained, the wavelength range used and the types of electrons and orbitals involved. (4 marks)
(UV-Visible spectroscopy ka usool samjhayein: kya napa jata hai, absorbance kaise milti hai, kaun si wavelength range istemal hoti hai aur kaun se electrons aur orbitals shamil hain.)
blocks.explanation:
UV-Vis spectroscopy mashhoor, kai kaamon wali aur aasan analytical technique hai.

Kya napa jata hai: UV-Vis light sample se guzari jati hai aur transmittance (T) napi jati hai. Absorbance A = −log (T) se milti hai. UV-Vis spectrum mukhtalif wavelengths par absorbance dikhata hai; kisi wavelength par absorbance molecule ki electronic structure ki wajah se hai.

Range: electronic energy levels ki tabdeeli study karne ke liye 200-800 nm ki wavelengths.

Electrons ki qismein: σ electrons (σ-bonds), π electrons (sirf unsaturated compounds) aur n electrons (non-bonded).
Orbitals ki energy: σ bonding < π bonding < non-bonding (n).

Transitions: sahi frequency ki radiation jazb hone par electron bhare orbital (π ya n) se khaali anti-bonding orbital (σ* ya π*) mein jata hai. Ahem transitions π → π*, n → π* aur n → σ* hain. Har jump khaas wavelength ki light se energy leta hai.

book_ref.quote: Ultraviolet-visible (UV-Vis) spectroscopy is one of the most popular analytical techniques

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Book correction: Figure 29.4 mein n level ko 'anti-bonding' likha hai. n electrons lone pairs hain, is liye yeh n (non-bonding) level hai.

blocks.prompt:
9 Describe the UV-Visible spectrum of buta-1,3-diene. Explain how the extent of conjugation affects λmax, using butadiene, hexatriene and octatetraene. (4 marks)
(Buta-1,3-diene ka UV-Visible spectrum bayan karein. Butadiene, hexatriene aur octatetraene ki madad se samjhayein ke conjugation ki wusat λmax par kaise asar daalti hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Buta-1,3-diene, CH₂=CH–CH=CH₂: 217 nm wali absorption peak sab se zyada absorption ki wavelength λmax hai. Yeh UV region mein hai, is liye koi visible light jazb nahi hoti aur compound be-rang hai. Is mein non-bonding electrons nahi, is liye napi range mein sirf π → π* jumps hote hain.

Conjugation ka asar: λmax conjugation ki wusat par bohat munhasir hai.
1. Conjugated system mein atoms lambi zanjeer par electrons share karte hain. Jitna zyada conjugated, utne zyada energy levels aur un ke darmiyan utne chhote gaps.
2. Chhote gaps ki wajah se electron excite karne ko kam energy chahiye, is liye kam energy (kam frequency, lambi wavelength) ki light jazb hoti hai.
3. Is liye jitne zyada conjugated double bonds, utna zyada λmax; har izaafi double bond se λmax aam tor par 30 se 40 nm barhta hai. Bohat conjugated compounds aksar chamakdar rang rakhte hain.

Butadiene (2 C=C, 217 nm) < hexatriene (3 C=C) < octatetraene (4 C=C, 290 nm). λmax dekh kar conjugation ki wusat maloom ki ja sakti hai.

book_ref.quote: In a conjugated system, atoms share electrons across a long chain

blocks.prompt:
10 In a UV-Vis measurement, (i) sample P transmits 40% and sample Q transmits 20% of the light at λmax. Calculate the absorbance of each. (ii) A third sample has absorbance 0.30; what percentage of light does it transmit? Which of the three absorbs most? (4 marks)
(UV-Vis paimaish mein (i) sample P λmax par 40% aur sample Q 20% light guzarta hai. Har aik ki absorbance nikalein. (ii) Teesre sample ki absorbance 0.30 hai; yeh kitne percent light guzarta hai? Teenon mein se kaun sab se zyada jazb karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: T ko fraction mein likh kar A = −log T lagayein; ulta hisaab T = 10⁻ᴬ. Jitni zyada A, utni zyada light jazb.

book_ref.quote: The absorbance (A) can be determined from the transmittance (T) using the formula A = −log (T)

steps: Teesra sample: T = 10⁻⁰·³⁰ = 0.501, yani taqreeban 50% guzarta hai
Absorbances: Q (0.70) > P (0.40) > teesra (0.30), is liye Q sab se zyada jazb karta hai
blocks.final_answer: A(P) = 0.40, A(Q) = 0.70; teesra sample taqreeban 50% guzarta hai; Q sab se zyada jazb karta hai

blocks.prompt:
11 Explain the principle of infrared spectroscopy. Which molecules are IR inactive and why? Why do some bonds absorb at higher wavenumbers? Name the two regions of an IR spectrum. (4 marks)
(Infrared spectroscopy ka usool samjhayein. Kaun se molecules IR inactive hain aur kyun? Kuch bonds zyada wavenumbers par kyun jazb karte hain? IR spectrum ke do regions ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Usool: tamaam covalent bonds springs ki tarah kaam karte hain aur kai tarah se vibrate karte hain (Figure 29.6). Vibration frequencies infrared region mein hain. Agar molecule par us ke bonds ki qudrati vibration frequency ke barabar IR energy daali jaye to woh kuch energy jazb karta hai aur vibration ka amplitude barh jata hai. IR spectroscopy vibrations ki in tabdeeliyon se compounds pehchanti hai; spectrophotometer sample par IR dalta hai aur jazb radiation pakarta hai.

IR inactive molecules: IR energy sirf tab jazb hoti hai jab molecule ka permanent dipole vibration ke saath badle. Symmetrical aur non-polar molecules jaise O₂ aur H₂ ka aisa dipole nahi, is liye yeh IR inactive hain.

Zyada wavenumbers: polar bonds (O–H, N–H), chhoti bond length wale bonds aur multiple bonds (maslan HC≡CH) zyada wavenumbers par jazb karte hain kyun ke yeh bonds mazboot hain aur zyada energy chahte hain.

Regions: fingerprint region 1500 cm⁻¹ se neeche aur functional group region 1500 cm⁻¹ se ooper. Functional group region organic compound ki nature samajhne ke liye kaafi hai.

book_ref.quote: If an organic molecule is irradiated with the infra-red energy that matches the natural vibration frequency of its bonds

blocks.prompt:
12 Describe the characteristic IR absorptions of an alcohol, an amine, an amide and a carboxylic acid. (4 marks)
(Alcohol, amine, amide aur carboxylic acid ki khaas IR absorptions bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Alcohol (maslan butan-2-ol): O–H group 3600–3200 cm⁻¹ par mazboot absorption dikhata hai; 3000 cm⁻¹ wali peak sp³ C–H bonds ki wajah se hai.

Amine (maslan octylamine): N–H bond 3300 aur 3400 cm⁻¹ par do kamzor absorptions deta hai. N–H signal chaurra hai magar alcohol ke O–H signal se zyada nahi.

Amide (maslan propanamide): N–H aur C=O dono 1500 cm⁻¹ se ooper: N–H (do peaks) 3200 aur 3400 cm⁻¹ par; C=O 1660 cm⁻¹ par.

Carboxylic acid: C=O 1700 cm⁻¹ par mazboot absorption aur 2500 se 3300 cm⁻¹ ke darmiyan chaurra, gehra O–H absorption, jis ka daayan hissa aksar C–H peaks se bigar jata hai.

book_ref.quote: An amide exhibits absorptions above 1500 cm⁻¹ for both its N−H and C=O groups

blocks.prompt:
13 Using Table 29.2, explain how IR spectroscopy can distinguish (i) propanoic acid, (ii) propan-1-ol, (iii) propanone and (iv) propanenitrile, CH₃CH₂C≡N. (4 marks)
(Table 29.2 ki madad se samjhayein ke IR spectroscopy (i) propanoic acid, (ii) propan-1-ol, (iii) propanone aur (iv) propanenitrile, CH₃CH₂C≡N, mein kaise farq karti hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Charon mein alkane C–H bonds (2850–2950 cm⁻¹) hain, is liye farq functional group region (1500 cm⁻¹ se ooper) se hota hai:

(i) Propanoic acid (carboxyl): 1670–1740 cm⁻¹ (taqreeban 1700) par C=O aur 2500–3300 cm⁻¹ par bohat chaurra O–H band.
(ii) Propan-1-ol (hydroxy): 3200–3600 cm⁻¹ par mazboot O–H band aur koi C=O band nahi; C–O 1040–1300 cm⁻¹ par.
(iii) Propanone (carbonyl, ketone): 1710 cm⁻¹ ke qareeb mazboot, tez C=O band aur koi O–H band nahi.
(iv) Propanenitrile: 2200–2250 cm⁻¹ par C≡N band, koi O–H ya C=O band nahi.

Yun O–H, C=O aur C≡N bands ki maujoodgi ya ghair maujoodgi aur O–H band ki chaurai se har compound pehchana jata hai.

book_ref.quote: The table below gives information about infrared absorption frequencies (wave numbers).

blocks.prompt:
14 Describe two everyday applications of infrared spectroscopy given in the chapter and explain the principle behind each. (4 marks)
(Chapter mein di gayi infrared spectroscopy ki do rozmarra applications bayan karein aur har aik ka usool samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Usool: polar bonds wale molecules apne bonds ke khaas wavenumbers par IR radiation jazb karte hain; jitne zyada molecules, utni zyada absorbance.

1. Roadside breathalyser: breathalyser chamber mein kharij saans se infrared radiation ki shua guzari jati hai. Ethanol ke khaas bonds pakre aur nape jate hain; jitni zyada IR absorbance, saans mein utna zyada ethanol.

2. Gaariyon ki aaloodgi ki nigrani: air sensors IR spectroscopy se gaariyon ke dhuen mein pollutants pehchante hain. Yeh carbon monoxide, carbon dioxide aur na-jale hydrocarbons pakarte aur napte hain. Yeh motorways aur masroof shehri ilaqon mein maqami aaloodgi ki nigrani ke liye hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Infrared spectroscopy can be used to measure alcohol levels using modern roadside breathalyser

blocks.prompt:
15 Explain the principle of mass spectrometry. What is a molecular ion and how is the molecular ion peak used to find molecular mass? Illustrate with propanal and butanal. (4 marks)
(Mass spectrometry ka usool samjhayein. Molecular ion kya hai aur molecular ion peak se molecular mass kaise maloom hoti hai? Propanal aur butanal ki misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation:
Usool: mass spectrometry na-maloom compounds ki pehchan ki analytical technique hai. Chhote sample ke molecules/atoms par zyada energy wale electrons ki bombardment hoti hai jis se woh aik electron kho dete hain. Bane positive ions detect ho kar m/e (mass to charge ratio) banam ion ke percentage ki shakal mein record hote hain.

Molecular ion: poora molecule jis ne aik electron kho diya; yeh positive hai aur is mein aik unpaired electron hai:
Molecule → (electron bombardment) → Molecule⁺• + e⁻
Yeh mazeed toot kar naye ions, molecules aur free radicals bana sakta hai.

Molecular mass: har peak aik khaas m/e wale fragment ki hai. Zyada tar sab se zyada m/e wali peak molecular ion (M⁺) peak hai jo molecular mass batati hai.

Misaal: propanal CH₃CH₂CHO⁺ ka m/e 58 aur butanal CH₃CH₂CH₂CHO⁺ ka m/e 72 hai. Jis spectrum ki molecular ion peak 58 par ho woh propanal ka hai.

book_ref.quote: When molecules in a sample compound are bombarded with highly accelerated electrons

blocks.prompt:
16 Answer both parts. (i) The mass spectrum of an element shows peaks at m/e 24, 25 and 26 with relative abundances 79.0%, 10.0% and 11.0%. Calculate its relative atomic mass to 2 decimal places. (ii) Another element has two isotopes of mass 63 and 65 and Aᵣ = 63.55. Find the percentage abundance of each isotope. (4 marks)
(Dono hisson ka jawab dein. (i) Aik element ka mass spectrum m/e 24, 25 aur 26 par 79.0%, 10.0% aur 11.0% relative abundance ki peaks dikhata hai. Us ka relative atomic mass 2 decimal tak nikalein. (ii) Aik aur element ke do isotopes mass 63 aur 65 hain aur Aᵣ = 63.55. Har isotope ka percentage abundance nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Aᵣ = Σ(isotopic mass × abundance)/100; ulte hisaab mein aik abundance x% aur doosri (100 − x)% lein.

book_ref.quote: The relative atomic mass of an element can be calculated by using the relative abundance and isotopic masses

blocks.prompt:
17 Why is fragmentation used to identify molecules in mass spectrometry? Explain the fragmentation of straight-chain hexane with the m/e values of its fragments. (4 marks)
(Mass spectrometry mein molecules ki pehchan ke liye fragmentation kyun istemal hoti hai? Seedhi zanjeer wale hexane ki fragmentation us ke fragments ki m/e qeematon ke saath samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Zaroorat: molecular ion peak molecular mass batati hai, magar mukhtalif compounds ki molecular mass aik jaisi ho sakti hai. Structure maloom karne ke liye fragmentation istemal hoti hai: fragments khaas chhote ions ya chhote molecules ke nikalne se aate hain, maslan 18 (H₂O), 29 (C₂H₅⁺) aur 44 (CO₂) par peaks.

Alkanes: saada alkanes C–C bonds tootne se fragment hote hain. Seedhi zanjeer wala hexane, CH₃–CH₂–CH₂–CH₂–CH₂–CH₃ (mass 86), mukhtalif jagahon se toot kar 86, 71, 57, 43, 29 aur 15 deta hai:
CH₃CH₂CH₂CH₂CH₂⁺ (C₅H₁₁⁺) = 71
CH₃CH₂CH₂CH₂⁺ (C₄H₉⁺) = 57
CH₃CH₂CH₂⁺ (C₃H₇⁺) = 43
CH₃CH₂⁺ (C₂H₅⁺) = 29
CH₃⁺ = 15

book_ref.quote: Fragments may appear due to the formation of characteristic smaller ions or the loss of small molecules

blocks.prompt:
18 Explain the origin of the [M+1] and [M+2] peaks in mass spectra. How do they help to find the number of carbon atoms and to detect chlorine and bromine? (4 marks)
(Mass spectra mein [M+1] aur [M+2] peaks kahan se aati hain, samjhayein. Yeh carbon atoms ki tadaad nikalne aur chlorine aur bromine pehchanne mein kaise madad karti hain?)
blocks.explanation:
[M+1] peak: carbon-13 ki wajah se, jo tamaam carbon atoms ka taqreeban 1.1% hai (¹³C : ¹²C ≈ 1 : 99). Yeh M peak se bohat chhoti hai, aur molecule mein jitne zyada carbon, utni bari (hexane ki [M+1] ethane se bari). Carbon atoms ki tadaad:
n = (100 × [M+1] ki abundance) / (1.1 × M⁺ ion ki abundance)

[M+2] peak: bromine ya chlorine atoms [M+2] aur shayad [M+4] peak dete hain.
• Aik Cl (³⁵Cl, ³⁷Cl): M⁺ (³⁵Cl) aur [M+2] (³⁷Cl) 3 : 1 mein, kyun ke ³⁵Cl 3 guna zyada hai.
• Do Cl: M⁺ (³⁵Cl + ³⁵Cl), [M+2] (³⁵Cl + ³⁷Cl), [M+4] (³⁷Cl + ³⁷Cl) 9 : 6 : 1 mein.
• Aik Br (⁷⁹Br, ⁸¹Br): M⁺ aur [M+2] 1 : 1 mein (barabar abundance).
• Do Br: M (⁷⁹Br + ⁷⁹Br), [M+2] (⁷⁹Br + ⁸¹Br), [M+4] (⁸¹Br + ⁸¹Br) 1 : 2 : 1 mein.

book_ref.quote: The presence of bromine or chlorine atoms in a compound gives rise to a [M+2] and possibly [M+4] peak

header: Molecular ion peaks aur unchai ka tanasub

blocks.prompt:
19 A hydrocarbon gives its molecular ion peak at m/e 86 with relative abundance 72, and an [M+1] peak at m/e 87 with relative abundance 4.75. (i) Find the number of carbon atoms. (ii) Deduce the molecular formula and its IHD (C = 12, H = 1). (iii) Give the m/e values of two C–C fragment ions expected if it is a straight-chain compound. (4 marks)
(Aik hydrocarbon ki molecular ion peak m/e 86 par 72 relative abundance ke saath aur [M+1] peak m/e 87 par 4.75 abundance ke saath hai. (i) Carbon atoms ki tadaad nikalein. (ii) Molecular formula aur us ka IHD nikalein (C = 12, H = 1). (iii) Agar yeh seedhi zanjeer wala ho to do C–C fragment ions ki m/e qeematein batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Carbon ke liye n = 100 × [M+1]/(1.1 × M⁺) lagayein, M⁺ mein se carbon ki mass nikaal kar hydrogen nikalein, phir IHD ke liye CₙH₂ₙ₊₂ se milayein.

book_ref.quote: The number of carbon atoms, n, in a compound can be deduced using the [M+1] peak and the following formula:

steps: Carbon ki mass = 6 × 12 = 72; hydrogen = 86 − 72 = 14, formula C₆H₁₄
C₆H₁₄ CₙH₂ₙ₊₂ (2 × 6 + 2 = 14) ke mutabiq hai, is liye IHD = 0 (alkane, hexane)
Seedhi zanjeer ke fragments, maslan C₅H₁₁⁺ = 71 aur C₄H₉⁺ = 57 (aur 43, 29, 15)
blocks.final_answer: 6 carbon atoms; C₆H₁₄ (hexane), IHD = 0; fragments maslan 71 aur 57

blocks.prompt:
20 A compound of carbon, hydrogen and one halogen shows molecular ion peaks at m/e 78 and 80 with heights in the ratio 3 : 1. The m/e 78 peak has relative abundance 30 and the [M+1] peak at 79 has relative abundance 0.99. (i) Identify the halogen. (ii) Find the number of carbon atoms. (iii) Deduce the molecular formula (C = 12, H = 1, Cl = 35 for the lighter isotope). (4 marks)
(Carbon, hydrogen aur aik halogen wala compound m/e 78 aur 80 par 3 : 1 unchai ke tanasub mein molecular ion peaks dikhata hai. m/e 78 peak ki relative abundance 30 aur m/e 79 wali [M+1] peak ki 0.99 hai. (i) Halogen pehchanein. (ii) Carbon atoms ki tadaad nikalein. (iii) Molecular formula nikalein (C = 12, H = 1, halke isotope ke liye Cl = 35).)
blocks.explanation: Do units ke faasle par 3 : 1 wali peaks ka jora aik chlorine atom batata hai; phir carbon ke liye [M+1] formula aur baqi mass se hydrogen nikalein.

book_ref.quote: A compound containing one chlorine atom will, therefore, have two molecular ion peaks

steps: M⁺ aur [M+2] 3 : 1 mein → aik chlorine atom (³⁵Cl se 78, ³⁷Cl se 80)
